# splashpy

> Python core of Splash Sync connectors (branch 3.0): any Python application exposes its data to
> Splash and notifies Splash of its changes. Wire protocol byte identical to Php-Core 3.0,
> Python 3.9 → 3.14, one runtime dependency (`cryptography`).

Read a page: `docs/<page>.md` in the repository, or `splashpy docs <page>` from any installation
(same pages, installed version). `splashpy docs` prints this index.

Rules for connector code:

- One `SplashClient` per database / tenant, one `RequestContext` per request: no global state.
- Objects are made of fields groups, ordered explicitly (priorities, `after` / `before`, phases),
  never by method names or imports. Check the order with `splashpy describe --order`.
- Build standard fields from templates (`create_from_template`, `template`), never write
  metadata by hand; declare scopes in `ClientInfo.scopes` or in an extension `client_info()`.
- Protocol strings come from `splashpy.dictionary` (services, operations, formats), never hardcoded.
- Values are flexible on input (`"1"`, `1`, `True`): convert them inside the connector, with
  `splashpy.fields` helpers and `Validators`.
- Validate a connector with the conformance suite (`splashpy.testing`), then the Splash Toolkit.
- The faker demo connector is for development and tests only, never enabled implicitly.

## Docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, build a client, serve Splash requests, debug page, call Splash, development server
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): settings, environment / JSON / static providers
- [Objects & fields groups](docs/objects.md): objects, ordered fields groups, phases, values helpers, files, commits
- [Extensions & widgets](docs/extensions.md): extensions registry and hooks, widgets, faker objects, files & commits endpoints
- [Contracts](docs/contracts.md): field templates, scopes, embedded catalog, cache and updates
- [Testing a connector](docs/testing.md): conformance suite for connectors, commits checks

## Optional

- [Project structure](docs/project-structure.md): repository layout, package layers, request flow
- [Development](docs/development.md): quality tools, tests, golden fixtures, Docker E2E stack, CI (splashpy contributors)
